finalText:
It builds clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset, so it threw instead of just treating that as disabled.

Fixed both call sites to match the new shapes. The rest was just deprecation warnings from the bump — still there, still harmless (8 of them), and the build finishes in 44.9s with 0 errors.
